# Gloww

> Gloww is a beauty app. Clients book verified makeup artists, hairstylists and other beauty professionals for weddings, receptions, festivals, photoshoots and everyday looks, at home or in the artist's salon.

## What Gloww does
- Book makeup, hair, nails, mehendi, waxing, threading and facial services from verified artists
- Choose an artist from their real work: posts, Looks and reviews
- Book for now or schedule a date, at home or at the artist's salon
- Chat with the artist and track their arrival on the day
- My Space: an AI skin scan that reads skin tone and type and suggests products, saved so you can see changes over time

## Who it is for
- Clients looking for a makeup artist or hairstylist for a wedding, reception, festival or photoshoot
- Beauty professionals who want bookings, a portfolio and a verified profile

## Where
- Gloww is available to clients and artists everywhere — it is not limited to a single city
- Artists in a growing number of cities; the skin scan works anywhere

## Links
- Website: https://gloww.dev
- Web app: https://app.gloww.dev
- Guides: https://gloww.dev/blog
- Contact: contact@gloww.dev

## Trust
- Artists are verified with identity and professional documents before they can take bookings
- Scan photos are only analysed with the user's consent and can be deleted from the app
